purpose: Phase-8A efflux-associated resistance: efflux tendency represented QUALITATIVELY through a normalized modifier. Individual transporter kinetics are NOT modelled and transporter names / expression levels are NEVER invented - specific transporters may be referenced only inside evidence-backed profiles (none in this build). Schematic ordinal only.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: availability_reduction in [0,1] (additive, bounded; efflux lowers effective intracellular availability)
coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic efflux-driven availability reduction the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: general efflux-mediated resistance biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: shares the availability channel with uptake resistance; the adapter normalizes to avoid double counting.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No transporter identity / expression / kinetics (all NOT_REPORTED).

rules.no_transporter_invention: No ABC transporter or pump is named unless an evidence-backed profile supplies it.
